ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat / ALPHV Sphynx Rust encryptor execution via `--access-token` and propagation flags
ucs.description: Hunts for execution of the BlackCat / ALPHV / Noberus ransomware binary by its distinctive Rust-encryptor command-line surface: the mandatory `--access-token <hex>` argument that decrypts the embedded config, plus the worm-variant flags `--child`, `--propagated`, `--no-prop-servers`, `--no-vm-kill`, and `--prop-file`. These flags are unique to BlackCat — no other RaaS family or legitimate Windows software uses this combination — so a single hit is high-confidence actor attribution.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*--access-token*" OR Processes.process="*--child*" OR Processes.process="*--propagated*" OR Processes.process="*--no-prop-servers*" OR Processes.process="*--no-vm-kill*" OR Processes.process="*--prop-file*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where match(process, "--access-token\s+[a-fA-F0-9]{16,}") OR match(process, "(--child|--propagated|--no-prop-servers|--no-vm-kill|--prop-file)(\s|$)")
| where NOT match(user, "(?i).*\$$")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--access-token", "--child", "--propagated", "--no-prop-servers", "--no-vm-kill", "--prop-file")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"--access-token\s+[a-fA-F0-9]{16,}"
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(^|\s)--(child|propagated|no-prop-servers|no-vm-kill|prop-file)(\s|$)"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("MsSense.exe","MsMpEng.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath,
          ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, MD5,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          IsAdmin = ProcessIntegrityLevel
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where CommandLine has_any ("--access-token", "--child", "--propagated", "--no-prop-servers", "--no-vm-kill", "--prop-file")
| where CommandLine matches regex @"--access-token\s+[a-fA-F0-9]{16,}"
   or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(^|\s)--(child|propagated|no-prop-servers|no-vm-kill|prop-file)(\s|$)"
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine,
          ParentProcessName, ProcessId, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BlackCat / ALPHV / Noberus Sphynx Encryptor Command-Line Flags
id: 5b6f7c1c-9c1e-4a4e-9b9d-blackcat-sphynx-cli
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of the BlackCat (ALPHV / Noberus) Rust-based ransomware encryptor by its distinctive `--access-token` configuration-decryption argument and the Sphynx worm propagation flags.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/07/06/the-five-day-job-a-blackcat-ransomware-intrusion-observed/
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/22/d/an-investigation-of-the-blackcat-ransomware.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1027
  - attack.g.blackcat
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_token:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)--access-token\s+[a-fA-F0-9]{16,}'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' --child '
      - ' --child\n'
      - ' --propagated'
      - ' --no-prop-servers'
      - ' --no-vm-kill'
      - ' --prop-file '
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_token or selection_flags) and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Extremely rare. No mainstream legitimate Windows software combines `--access-token <hex>` with `--child` / `--propagated` flags.
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) (@CommandLine:*--access-token* OR @CommandLine:*--child* OR @CommandLine:*--propagated* OR @CommandLine:*--no-prop-servers* OR @CommandLine:*--no-vm-kill* OR @CommandLine:*--prop-file*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| CommandLine=/--access-token\s+[a-fA-F0-9]{16,}/i OR CommandLine=/(^|\s)--(child|propagated|no-prop-servers|no-vm-kill|prop-file)(\s|$)/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, SHA256HashData], function=[count(as=Hits), collect([CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, ParentImageFileName])])
| Hits >= 1
ucs.rationale: BlackCat / ALPHV / Noberus is the only widely-tracked RaaS family whose Rust-written encryptor REQUIRES the operator-supplied `--access-token <hex>` to RC4-decrypt its embedded configuration; without it, the binary refuses to run. ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat / ALPHV pre-encryption recovery-and-evidence purge chain spawned from one non-shell parent
ucs.description: Detects the BlackCat encryptor's deterministic Windows preparation sequence: from a single parent process the binary spawns multiple `cmd.exe` children that run `vssadmin Delete Shadows /all /quiet`, `wmic shadowcopy delete`, `bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled No`, `bcdedit /set {default} bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures`, `iisreset.exe /stop`, `wevtutil cl`, `fsutil behavior set SymlinkEvaluation`, and `arp -a` — all within ~60-120 seconds of one another. The signal is the chain (≥4 distinct recovery-disable / log-clear / IIS-stop commands sharing one non-shell grandparent), not any si
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd_samples values(Processes.process_id) as child_pids dc(Processes.process) as distinct_cmds from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="cmd.exe" AND (Processes.process="*vssadmin*delete*shadow*" OR Processes.process="*wmic*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*recoveryenabled*No*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*iisreset*/stop*" OR Processes.process="*wevtutil*cl *" OR Processes.process="*fsutil*SymlinkEvaluation*" OR Processes.process="* arp* -a*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_id
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where distinct_cmds >= 4 AND (lastTime - firstTime) <= 120
| where NOT match(parent_process_name, "(?i)(cmd|powershell|pwsh|explorer|mmc|wmiprvse|services|msiexec|conhost)\.exe$")
| where NOT match(user, "(?i).*\$$")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowSeconds = 120;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where FileName =~ "cmd.exe"
| where (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("vssadmin","elete","hadows"))
     or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("wmic","shadowcopy","delete"))
     or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("bcdedit","recoveryenabled","No"))
     or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("bcdedit","bootstatuspolicy","ignoreallfailures"))
     or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("iisreset","/stop"))
     or (ProcessCommandLine has "wevtutil cl ")
     or (ProcessCommandLine has "fsutil behavior set SymlinkEvaluation")
     or (ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\barp(\.exe)?\s+-a\b")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctCmds  = dcount(ProcessCommandLine),
            CmdSamples    = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 12)
         by DeviceName, AccountName,
            GrandparentPid  = InitiatingProcessId,
            GrandparentName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
            GrandparentPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
            GrandparentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
            GrandparentSHA  = InitiatingProcessSHA256
| where DistinctCmds >= 4
| where datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen) <= WindowSeconds
| where GrandparentName !in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","explorer.exe","mmc.exe","wmiprvse.exe","services.exe","msiexec.exe","conhost.exe","taskhostw.exe")
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowSeconds = 120;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\cmd.exe"
| where (CommandLine has_all ("vssadmin","elete","hadows"))
     or (CommandLine has_all ("wmic","shadowcopy","delete"))
     or (CommandLine has_all ("bcdedit","recoveryenabled","No"))
     or (CommandLine has_all ("bcdedit","bootstatuspolicy","ignoreallfailures"))
     or (CommandLine has_all ("iisreset","/stop"))
     or (CommandLine has "wevtutil cl ")
     or (CommandLine has "fsutil behavior set SymlinkEvaluation")
     or (CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\barp(\.exe)?\s+-a\b")
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctCmds = dcount(CommandLine),
            CmdSamples   = make_set(CommandLine, 12),
            ChildPids    = make_set(NewProcessId, 12)
         by Computer, TargetUserName, ParentProcessName
| where DistinctCmds >= 4
| where datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen) <= WindowSeconds
| where not(ParentProcessName endswith "\\cmd.exe")
   and not(ParentProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe")
   and not(ParentProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe")
   and not(ParentProcessName endswith "\\explorer.exe")
   and not(ParentProcessName endswith "\\mmc.exe")
   and not(ParentProcessName endswith "\\wmiprvse.exe")
   and not(ParentProcessName endswith "\\services.exe")
   and not(ParentProcessName endswith "\\msiexec.exe")
   and not(ParentProcessName endswith "\\conhost.exe")
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) (@Image:(*\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\Cmd.exe)) (@CommandLine:(*vssadmin* *delete* *shadow*) OR @CommandLine:(*wmic* *shadowcopy* *delete*) OR @CommandLine:(*bcdedit* *recoveryenabled* *No*) OR @CommandLine:(*bcdedit* *bootstatuspolicy* *ignoreallfailures*) OR @CommandLine:(*iisreset* *\/stop*) OR @CommandLine:(*wevtutil* *cl *) OR @CommandLine:(*fsutil* *SymlinkEvaluation*) OR @CommandLine:(* arp* * -a*)) -@User:*$ -@ParentImage:(*\cmd.exe OR *\powershell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\explorer.exe OR *\mmc.exe OR *\wmiprvse.exe OR *\services.exe OR *\msiexec.exe OR *\conhost.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\cmd\.exe$/i
| (CommandLine=/vssadmin.*delete.*shadows/i OR CommandLine=/wmic.*shadowcopy.*delete/i OR CommandLine=/bcdedit.*recoveryenabled.*no/i OR CommandLine=/bcdedit.*bootstatuspolicy.*ignoreallfailures/i OR CommandLine=/iisreset.*\/stop/i OR CommandLine=/wevtutil\s+cl\s/i OR CommandLine=/fsutil\s+behavior\s+set\s+SymlinkEvaluation/i OR CommandLine=/\barp(\.exe)?\s+-a\b/i)
| NOT ParentBaseFileName=/^(cmd|powershell|pwsh|explorer|mmc|wmiprvse|services|msiexec|conhost)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ParentImageFileName], function=[count(field=CommandLine, distinct=true, as=DistinctCmds), min(_time, as=FirstSeen), max(_time, as=LastSeen), collect([CommandLine])])
| WindowSec := LastSeen - FirstSeen
| DistinctCmds >= 4
| WindowSec <= 120
